title: Scientists discover the hidden “muscles” trees use to straighten themselves
caption:
Researchers discovered that trees can act like they have muscles, using special wood to pull themselves upright. This internal sense could help breed straighter timber and sturdier crops, though it’s still early lab work.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover the hidden “muscles” trees use to straighten themselves

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261030003006.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
